14. DIVIDENDS
Directors recommend that the Board approves the proposal to declare final dividend of Kshs 5.5 per share (2024:
Kshs 6.0 per share) amounting to Kshs 4.35 billion (2024: Kshs 4.74 billion). An interim dividend of Kshs 2.50 per
share for 2025 (2024: Kshs 1 per share) was paid in April 2025. The total dividend pay-out for the year will therefore be
Kshs 8.0 per share (2024: Kshs 7.0 per share) amounting to Kshs 6.33 billion (2024: Kshs 5.54 billion).
Payment of dividends is subject to withholding tax at a rate of 0%, 5%, 10% and 15% depending on the residence and the
percentage shareholding of the respective shareholders.
